signal: Endor Labs acquired Autonomous Plane and launched AURI, an AI-coding security tool, after a $93M Series B

email.subject1: a signal play for Endor Labs
email.body1:
Zack, saw Endor Labs acquired Autonomous Plane and launched AURI to secure AI-generated code.

A fast product expansion like that usually opens more in-market accounts than the team can cover before they cool, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Endor off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Zack, quick follow-up for Endor Labs.

With 30x ARR growth and a broader platform, the pipeline target climbs faster than reps can ramp. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Endor needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Zack, last bit of proof for Endor Labs.

Memgraph, a fellow dev-infrastructure company, had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks.

I pulled a benchmark of how Endor's reply rate likely compares to other AppSec startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Zack, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters most mid-expansion, and I know absorbing an acquisition while shipping new products is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an AppSec motion? I will tailor it to Endor either way.
